ambient_events: A doorman's whistle carries from the canopy, hailing a cab that never comes.
The glass curtain-wall throws the whole grey street back at you, cleaner than it is.
description: Solenne Residences: a slim stem of champagne glass on a stone podium, turning gently on the way up and flaring at the top into a wide crown, a helipad and a teak roof terrace standing out over the street. A stone portal stands out of the podium, a gold sunburst over sliding glass doors and a brass-lettered canopy out to the kerb. Step north.
name: Solenne Residences
